title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
title_zh: 通过分层语义手术实现文本到图像扩散模型中的组合概念擦除

paragraphs.en: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute–noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 29.54 to 10.02 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E E and Attr P P scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched SS baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.

paragraphs.en: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model [ Rombach et al.(2022)Rombach, Blattmann, Lorenz, Esser, and Ommer ] is now a practical requirement. Real prompts, however, are compositional. A target may be invoked through hierarchical or implicit reference, and modifiers often remain bound to objects that the erasure procedure is trying to remove. paragraphs.en: Existing methods occupy two deployment regimes. Weight-editing methods—ESD [ Gandikota et al.(2023)Gandikota, Materzyńska, Fiotto-Kaufman, and Bau ] , UCE [ Gandikota et al.(2024)Gandikota, Orgad, Belinkov, Materzyńska, and Bau ] , MACE [ Lu et al.(2024)Lu, Wang, Li, Liu, and Kong ] , and related approaches (Sec. 2 )—can be strong on fixed targets. However, they modify the model or attach learned modules, and each edit incurs a training, storage, and distribution-shift cost. Training-free methods—SLD [ Schramowski et al.(2023)Schramowski, Brack, Deiseroth, and Kersting ] , SAFREE [ Yoon et al.(2025)Yoon, Yu, Patil, Yao, and Bansal ] , and Semantic Surgery (SS) [ Xiong et al.(2025)Xiong, Liu, Ye, Liu, and Xu ] —are lighter: the same checkpoint can serve many erase targets on demand. Their bottleneck is that the edit must be computed from the prompt itself. Any routing error in the text side therefore becomes an erasure failure.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法占据两种部署模式。 权重编辑方法——ESD [ Gandikota 等人（2023）Gandikota, Materzyńska, Fiotto-Kaufman 和 Bau ]、UCE [ Gandikota 等人（2024）Gandikota, Orgad, Belinkov, Materzyńska 和 Bau ]、MACE [ Lu 等人（2024）Lu, Wang, Li, Liu 和 Kong ] 及相关方法（第 2 节）——在固定目标上表现强劲。 然而，这些方法会修改模型或附加可学习的模块，每次编辑都会产生训练、存储和分布偏移的成本。 无需训练的方法——SLD [ Schramowski 等人（2023）Schramowski, Brack, Deiseroth 和 Kersting ]、SAFREE [ Yoon 等人（2025）Yoon, Yu, Patil, Yao 和 Bansal ] 以及语义手术（SS）[ Xiong 等人（2025）Xiong, Liu, Ye, Liu 和 Xu ]——更为轻量：同一个检查点可根据需求服务于多个擦除目标。 它们的瓶颈在于，编辑必须从提示本身计算得出。 因此，文本侧的任何路由错误都会导致擦除失败。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical evasion. When the prompt does not lexicalize the erase target, similarity-based selection misses descendants of the target. For example, the prompt “a poodle running in the park” under target “mammal” still produces a mammal, because “poodle” is not lexically matched. The parent-to-child case is ambiguous in the opposite direction: “flower” may instantiate the fine-grained target “rose”, and routing the edit through the parent risks suppressing non-target flowers. On the SEE evasion axis, SS remained vulnerable, with a 29.54 29.54 average despite strong neighboring erasure.
paragraphs.zh: 层级规避。 当提示未对删除目标进行词汇化时，基于相似性的选择会遗漏该目标的子项。 例如，在目标为“哺乳动物”的情况下，提示“一只在公园里奔跑的贵宾犬”仍然会产生一个哺乳动物，因为“贵宾犬”并未与目标词汇匹配。 从父节点到子节点的情况在相反方向上存在歧义：“花”可能实例化细粒度目标“玫瑰”，而通过父节点执行编辑则有可能抑制非目标的花卉。 在 SEE 规避维度上，SS 仍然容易受到攻击，尽管邻近的删除操作表现强劲，其平均值仍为 29.54。

paragraphs.en: Attribute leakage. Cross-attention text-side subtraction projects an aggregate direction and cannot determine whether a modifier such as “blue” belongs to the target noun or to a preserved one. As a result, attributes of the target can migrate onto preserved objects: “a blue car next to a dog” becomes a blue dog . On the SEE attribute-leakage axis, SS’s pairwise CLIP Attr E E exceeded twice that of weight-edit baselines (Attr P P was roughly 1.4 × 1.4\times theirs).

paragraphs.en: These two failures, visualised in Figure 1 , share a structural cause. SS treats the prompt as a set of candidate terms and routes a single concept direction through lexical–CLIP similarity. This primitive represents neither the hierarchy that relates a target to its descendants nor the binding that ties an attribute to its noun. A larger SS subtraction can sharpen the edit on lexicalized targets. It cannot, however, recover an unselected descendant token or decide which noun a modifier should remain bound to. The remedy must therefore replace the structural primitives rather than re-tune the existing scalars.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 中展示的这两种失败情况具有相同的结构性原因。 SS 将提示视为一组候选术语，并通过词汇-CLIP相似性引导单一概念方向。 这种基础结构既不能表示目标与其子项之间的关系层级，也不能表示属性与其名词之间的绑定关系。 更大的 SS 减法可以增强对已词汇化的目标的编辑效果。 然而，它无法恢复未选中的子项词元，也无法决定修饰符应与哪个名词保持绑定。 因此，解决方案必须替换结构性基础元素，而不是重新调整现有的标量参数。

paragraphs.en: A structural framing for compositional erasure. Existing training-free erasure methods treat prompt terms as loosely related routing cues. HGSS instead views concept erasure as the inverse objective to compositional generation. paragraphs.en: A large body of work edits the diffusion model itself to remove a target concept. Fine-tuning objectives steer the generator away from the target distribution. ESD [ Gandikota et al.(2023)Gandikota, Materzyńska, Fiotto-Kaufman, and Bau ] fine-tunes U-Net attention with a negative-guidance loss, Concept Ablation [ Kumari et al.(2023)Kumari, Zhang, Wang, Shechtman, Zhang, and Zhu ] matches a surrogate concept, and AdvUnlearn [ Zhang et al.(2024c)Zhang, Chen, Jia, Zhang, Fan, Liu, Hong, Ding, and Liu ] optimises adversarial robustness during erasure. Closed-form and low-rank weight edits act directly on cross-attention projections without full fine-tuning. UCE [ Gandikota et al.(2024)Gandikota, Orgad, Belinkov, Materzyńska, and Bau ] and RECE [ Gong et al.(2024)Gong, Chen, Wei, Chen, and Jiang ] apply closed-form edits, MACE [ Lu et al.(2024)Lu, Wang, Li, Liu, and Kong ] targets many concepts jointly, and SPM [ Lyu et al.(2024)Lyu, Yang, Hong, Chen, Jin, He, Xue, Han, and Ding ] uses one-dimensional adapters. Sparsity- and saliency-guided edits localise the intervention to a subset of parameters. SalUn [ Fan et al.(2024)Fan, Liu, Zhang, Wong, Wei, and Liu ] uses gradient-based weight saliency, SAeUron [ Cywiński and Deja(2025) ] edits sparse-autoencoder features, and ConceptPrune [ Chavhan et al.(2025)Chavhan, Li, and Hospedales ] prunes skilled neurons. Locality-oriented and representation-space methods reduce collateral damage by constraining where the edit applies. CPE [ Lee et al.(2025b)Lee, Lim, Lee, Kang, and Chun ] introduces residual attention gates, GLoCE [ Lee et al.(2025a)Lee, Lim, and Chun ] gates a training-free low-rank adaptation, and AdaVD [ Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Li, Mu, Hao, Liu, Wang, and He ] edits the value space along orthogonal complements. A further line refines target geometry : AGE [ Bui et al.(2025)Bui, Vu, Vuong, Le, Montague, Abraham, Kim, and Phung ] identifies which concepts to push erased samples toward, while CoGFD [ Nie et al.(2025)Nie, Yao, Liu, Wang, and Bian ] explicitly handles combinations of erase targets rather than single nouns. These methods exploit additional parameter capacity to retain preserve-side fidelity, but require per-target training and modified checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究通过修改扩散模型本身来移除目标概念。 微调目标会将生成器引导远离目标分布。 ESD [ Gandikota et al.(2023)Gandikota, Materzyńska, Fiotto-Kaufman, and Bau ] 使用负引导损失对 U-Net 注意力进行微调，Concept Ablation [ Kumari et al.(2023)Kumari, Zhang, Wang, Shechtman, Zhang, and Zhu ] 匹配代理概念，而 AdvUnlearn [ Zhang et al.(2024c)Zhang, Chen, Jia, Zhang, Fan, Liu, Hong, Ding, and Liu ] 则在擦除过程中优化对抗性鲁棒性。 闭式形式和低秩权重修改无需完整微调，即可直接作用于交叉注意力投影。 UCE [ Gandikota et al.(2024)Gandikota, Orgad, Belinkov, Materzyńska, and Bau ] 和 RECE [ Gong et al.(2024)Gong, Chen, Wei, Chen, and Jiang ] 应用闭式形式修改，MACE [ Lu et al.(2024)Lu, Wang, Li, Liu, and Kong ] 同时针对多个概念，而 SPM [ Lyu et al.(2024)Lyu, Yang, Hong, Chen, Jin, He, Xue, Han, and Ding ] 使用一维适配器。 稀疏性和显著性引导的修改将干预限制在参数子集内。 SalUn [ Fan et al.(2024)Fan, Liu, Zhang, Wong, Wei, and Liu ] 使用基于梯度的权重显著性，SAeUron [ Cywiński and Deja(2025) ] 修改稀疏自编码器特征，而 ConceptPrune [ Chavhan et al.(2025)Chavhan, Li, and Hospedales ] 则剪除技能神经元。 局部性和表示空间方法通过限制修改的应用范围来减少附带损害。 CPE [ Lee et al.(2025b)Lee, Lim, Lee, Kang, and Chun ] 引入残差注意力门，GLoCE [ Lee et al.(2025a)Lee, Lim, and Chun ] 对无需训练的自适应进行低秩适配控制，而 AdaVD [ Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Li, Mu, Hao, Liu, Wang, and He ] 则沿正交补空间修改值空间。 另一类方法优化目标几何结构：AGE [ Bui et al.(2025)Bui, Vu, Vuong, Le, Montague, Abraham, Kim, and Phung ] 确定擦除样本应被引导至哪些概念，而 CoGFD [ Nie et al.(2025)Nie, Yao, Liu, Wang, and Bian ] 则显式处理多个擦除目标的组合，而非单个名词。 这些方法利用额外的参数容量来保持保留侧的保真度，但需要针对每个目标进行训练并修改检查点。

paragraphs.en: Training-free erasure preserves the base generator and intervenes only at sampling time. SLD [ Schramowski et al.(2023)Schramowski, Brack, Deiseroth, and Kersting ] modifies classifier-free guidance using a safety prompt; SAFREE [ Yoon et al.(2025)Yoon, Yu, Patil, Yao, and Bansal ] projects text embeddings away from unsafe directions before they enter the U-Net. TraSCE [ Jain et al.(2024)Jain, Kobayashi, Shibuya, Takida, Memon, Togelius, and Mitsufuji ] steers the denoising trajectory away from harmful regions via a localised loss-based guidance. Semantic Surgery (SS) [ Xiong et al.(2025)Xiong, Liu, Ye, Liu, and Xu ] subtracts a similarity-weighted concept direction from the conditioning hidden states. These methods are deployment-friendly since the same checkpoint serves many erase targets on demand, but their edits are only as reliable as the text-side signals that select the edited span. When the target is reached through a related class, a semantic variant, or an entangled attribute phrase, a single conditioning-time subtraction can fail in two ways. It can miss the routing path entirely, or remove content beyond the intended span.

paragraphs.en: Early erasure evaluations emphasise literal unsafe-content removal and clean-set image quality, exemplified by I2P [ Schramowski et al.(2023)Schramowski, Brack, Deiseroth, and Kersting ] with NudeNet-based scoring. UnlearnCanvas [ Zhang et al.(2024b)Zhang, Fan, Zhang, Yao, Jia, Liu, Zhang, Liu, Kompella, Liu, and Liu ] expands this view to style and object unlearning across 60 60 styles and 20 20 object classes. paragraphs.en: HGSS sits at the intersection of these lines by keeping the deployment advantage of training-free erasure but replacing the similarity-only routing used by prior inference-time methods with a hierarchical span grounding cascade. From text-side compositional control, HGSS reuses attribute–object binding primitives on the preserve side. HGSS inverts that framework’s objective by first routing target spans and descendants into the edit set, then re-applying binding control only to surviving spans, thereby treating concept erasure as the inverse objective to compositional generation , motivating the counterfactual reference and preserve-restricted attention pair in Sec. 3.4 .

paragraphs.en: HGSS makes two structural changes to the coarse-edit pipeline, which form two halves of the framework. Structured routing decides what to edit by using hierarchical span grounding instead of token-level similarity (Sec. 3.3 ). Structured edit decides how the edit evolves via dynamic attribute binding during denoising, rather than a single conditioning subtraction (Sec. 3.4 ). The two modules address hierarchical evasion and attribute leakage asymmetrically: structured routing supplies the main erase-side correction, while structured edit stabilises preserve-side bindings so the routing gain is not paid for by leakage onto surviving nouns. The two halves and the SS-inherited coarse edit between them comprise the visual pipeline in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: HGSS对粗略编辑流程进行了两项结构性调整，这两项调整构成了框架的两个部分。 结构化路由通过层级跨度定位而非词元级相似性来决定编辑内容（第3.3节）。 结构化编辑通过在降噪过程中动态绑定属性来决定编辑的演化方式，而非依赖单一的约束条件减法（第3.4节）。 这两个模块以非对称的方式处理了层级规避和属性泄露问题：结构化路由提供主要的删除侧修正，而结构化编辑则稳定保留侧的绑定，从而确保路由带来的增益不会因残留名词上的属性泄露而被抵消。 这两个部分以及它们之间继承自SS的粗略编辑共同构成了图2中的视觉流程。

paragraphs.en: Ground. The span-grounding module returns weighted erase spans 𝒜 E \mathcal{A}_{E} and preserve spans 𝒜 P \mathcal{A}_{P} in the prompt, using lexical, hierarchical, and semantic evidence.

sents.en: Ground.

paragraphs.en: Coarse edit. The coarse edit (Eq. ( 1 )) is applied using the grounded erase spans when available and falls back to the base similarity-driven selection otherwise, producing the static anchor c ~ \tilde{c} .

paragraphs.en: Bind. A text-side localization module builds counterfactual references and preserve-side attribute anchors; during denoising, the dynamic update refines the live conditioning c ¯ \bar{c} with attention and CLIP losses.
paragraphs.zh: 绑定。 一个文本侧的本地化模块构建反事实参照和保留侧的属性锚点；在去噪过程中，动态更新通过注意力和 CLIP 损失来优化实时的条件 c ¯ \bar{c}。

paragraphs.en: This module addresses hierarchical evasion : given prompt p p and target T e T_{e} , it returns the prompt spans that should be treated as erase-positive evidence, including spans that are hierarchical descendants of T e T_{e} when T e T_{e} itself does not appear lexically in p p . SS solves this with CLIP similarity alone, which is unreliable when T e T_{e} is not lexicalized. HGSS replaces this similarity-only test with a deterministic cascade that emits weighted (span, relation, confidence) tuples and removes false positives via guard rules so that the remaining tuples become the weighted erase set 𝒜 E \mathcal{A}_{E} and, by complement, the preserve set 𝒜 P \mathcal{A}_{P} .
paragraphs.zh: 该模块解决了层级规避问题：给定提示 p p 和目标 T e T_{e}，它会返回应被视作“擦除-积极证据”的提示片段，包括当 T e T_{e} 本身在 p p 中未以词形出现时，其作为 T e T_{e} 的层级子项的片段。 SS 仅依赖 CLIP 相似度来解决此问题，但当 T e T_{e} 未被词形化时，这种方法并不可靠。 HGSS 用一种确定性级联机制取代了这种仅基于相似度的测试，该机制会输出带有权重的（片段、关系、置信度）元组，并通过守卫规则移除误报，使得剩余的元组构成带有权重的擦除集 𝒜 E \mathcal{A}_{E}，而通过补集则得到保留集 𝒜 P \mathcal{A}_{P}。

paragraphs.en: The cascade consults three categories of evidence in order of signal reliability: lexical, taxonomic, and semantic. Lexical evidence provides high precision. Taxonomic evidence expands recall when lexical matches fail. And, semantic fallback handles open-vocabulary concepts beyond the lexicon. These three categories are visualised as the three labelled icons in Box 2 of Figure 2 and are realised through four sources, consulted in priority order. The first source that emits a confident candidate determines the relation label. (1) Lexical evidence tests exact equality, substring containment, and tokenized head-noun match between prompt term t k t_{k} and T e T_{e} . Exact matches are labelled self . (2a) Taxonomic backoff uses WordNet [ Miller(1995) ] to supply non-lexical evidence when lexical matching fails. The resolver looks up synsets for t k t_{k} and T e T_{e} and runs a breadth-first traversal of the hypernym/hyponym directed acyclic graph (DAG) with max depth 12 12 . The closest valid relation is classified as descendant / child (force-include), parent / parent-like , or sibling via shared hypernyms. A broad-hypernym guard suppresses generic ancestors ( entity , object , whole , artifact , organism , …) so that “car” and “apple” do not become hierarchically related through the root of the WordNet DAG. (2b) Activity bridge (a taxonomic refinement) handles verb-style targets and gerund-derived identifiers by expanding each candidate through WordNet derivational links into verb, gerund, and nominal variants, then applying the same relation and CLIP checks. The expansion is generated per prompt rather than taken from a hand-curated activity lexicon. (3) Semantic fallback admits a candidate when its CLIP cosine similarity to T e T_{e} exceeds a stage-specific threshold (distinct values for primary erase, derived modifiers, and activity targets; full settings are in App. B.1). This stage handles out-of-WordNet concepts (style names, brand names) without hand-curated lists.
paragraphs.zh: 级联机制按照信号可靠性的顺序查阅三类证据：词汇、分类和语义证据。 词汇证据可提供高精度结果。 当词汇匹配失败时，分类证据可扩大召回范围。 此外，语义兜底机制可处理超出词汇表范围的开放词汇概念。 这三类证据在图2的方框2中以三个带标签的图标形式可视化呈现，并通过四个按优先级顺序查阅的来源实现。 第一个输出高置信度候选项的来源将决定关系标签。 (1) 词汇证据检验提示术语 t_k t_{k} 与 T_e T_{e} 之间的精确相等、子字符串包含以及分词后的名词词头匹配。 精确匹配将被标记为“自身”。 (2a) 当词汇匹配失败时，分类回退机制使用 WordNet [Miller(1995)] 提供非词汇证据。 解析器会查找 t_k t_{k} 和 T_e T_{e} 的义元组，并对超义元/下义元有向无环图（DAG）进行最大深度为12的广度优先遍历。 通过共享超义元，最接近的有效关系将被分类为“后代/子项（强制包含）”、“父项/类父项”或“兄弟项”。 宽泛超义元守卫机制会抑制通用祖先（如“实体”“物体”“整体”“人造物”“生物体”等），从而避免“汽车”和“苹果”通过 WordNet DAG 的根节点产生层级关系。 (2b) “活动桥接”（一种分类细化）通过 WordNet 派生链接将每个候选项扩展为动词、动名词和名词变体，然后应用相同的关系和 CLIP 检查，以处理动词式目标和动名词衍生标识符。 该扩展是按需生成的，而非从人工编制的活动词汇表中获取。 (3) 当候选项与 T_e T_{e} 的 CLIP 余弦相似度超过特定阶段的阈值时，语义兜底机制会接纳该候选项（主删除、衍生修饰语和活动目标使用不同阈值；完整设置见附录 B.1）。 此阶段无需依赖人工编制的列表即可处理非 WordNet 概念（如风格名称和品牌名称）。

paragraphs.en: Two guard rules reduce the most common false-positive patterns in our development set:
paragraphs.zh: 两条守卫规则减少了我们开发集中最常见的假阳性模式：

paragraphs.en: Compound-head guard. For a compound noun t k = w 1 ​ w 2 ​ … ​ w n t_{k}=w_{1}\,w_{2}\,\ldots\,w_{n} , the derived head w n w_{n} is only erased if the full compound t k t_{k} has an erase-positive relation to T e T_{e} . A relation between only w n w_{n} and T e T_{e} in isolation will not necessarily trigger erasure. This prevents “ baseball bat ” from triggering erasure under a generic “mammal” target: the derived head “bat” is a mammal in WordNet, but the full compound “baseball bat” does not bear a descendant relation to mammal .
paragraphs.zh: 复合词头守卫。 对于一个复合名词 t k = w 1 ​ w 2 ​ … ​ w n t_{k}=w_{1}\,w_{2}\,\ldots\,w_{n}，其派生词头 w n w_{n} 仅当整个复合词 t k t_{k} 与 T e T_{e} 存在删除正向关系时才会被删除。 仅 w n w_{n} 与 T e T_{e} 之间的孤立关系并不一定会触发删除。 这可以防止“棒球棒”在目标为泛指的“哺乳动物”时触发删除：派生词头“bat”在 WordNet 中是哺乳动物，但整个复合词“baseball bat”与“mammal”不存在后代关系。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic Attribute Binding is not intended to be a standalone erasure mechanism. It refines the live conditioning during early DDIM steps so that, after the resolver-grounded coarse edit, the modifier–noun bindings on spans that should survive the erasure remain intact. A small gradient correction is applied to the conditioning embeddings during early DDIM steps, when object layout and attribute binding are still being established. The update combines two parts: a per-token counterfactual reference and a per-step composite loss. The reference anchors what each token position should encode after T e T_{e} is removed. The composite loss pulls each preserved (modifier, head-noun) pair together while pushing preserve-side keys away from the residue left by the coarse edit.

paragraphs.en: Three complementary benchmarks were used. (i) SEE [ Saha et al.(2025)Saha, Saha, Gaur, and Gokhale ] served as the primary diagnostic benchmark. Its three side-effect axes isolate the compositional failures targeted by HGSS: neighboring impact (SEE Table 2), evasion (SEE Table 3), and attribute leakage (SEE Table 4). The benchmark spans 11 11 super-categories with 79 79 base objects and 5,056 5{,}056 compositional variants. The official CLIP-based scoring protocol was followed and metrics were reported in the paper direction ( ↓ \downarrow for erase/evasion/leakage; ↑ \uparrow for preserve). Neighbor E E measures residual target evidence on erase-side prompts, while Neighbor P P measures preservation of related non-target concepts. Evasion measures target reappearance through hierarchical or related-class prompts. Attr E E and Attr P P measure pairwise attribute leakage on erase and preserve sides. (ii) UnlearnCanvas [ Zhang et al.(2024b)Zhang, Fan, Zhang, Yao, Jia, Liu, Zhang, Liu, Kompella, Liu, and Liu ] measures style and object unlearning quality. The evaluation covers the 50 50 style targets and 20 20 object targets defined by the official benchmark protocol (selected from the 60 60 -style UnlearnCanvas dataset). The reported metrics are the standard unlearning accuracy (UA), in-domain retention accuracy (IRA), and cross-domain retention accuracy (CRA) triple, with the six-metric average across style and object axes. FID was computed using a regenerated reference set with five images per combination. The SS and HGSS rows are therefore strictly comparable. UA measures target removal. IRA and CRA measure retention on in-domain and cross-domain non-target generations. (iii) I2P [ Schramowski et al.(2023)Schramowski, Brack, Deiseroth, and Kersting ] measures direct safety erasure. Per-class NudeNet detection counts are taken under the standard paper8 + threshold=0.6 protocol on all 4,703 4{,}703 I2P prompts across eight body-part classes. MS-COCO-30K FID and CLIP are reported as image-quality sanity checks.

paragraphs.en: HGSS has the strongest score among erasure methods on three columns: Neighbor E E /CLIP ( 8.08 8.08 ), evasion average ( 10.02 10.02 ), and Attr P P ( 38.30 38.30 ). On Neighbor E E , HGSS more than halves the previous overall best ( 23.08 23.08 from RECE [ Gong et al.(2024)Gong, Chen, Wei, Chen, and Jiang ] ). On evasion, it cuts the matched SS baseline from 29.54 29.54 to 10.02 10.02 ( − 66.1 % -66.1\% relative). On Attr P P , it drops from 82.22 82.22 to 38.30 38.30 ( − 53.4 % -53.4\% relative) which is the largest SS → \rightarrow HGSS leakage reduction in Table 1 . On Attr E E , HGSS reduces the matched SS baseline from 80.41 80.41 to 41.44 41.44 , but it does not close the gap to the strongest weight-edit baselines: RECE ( 24.43 24.43 ) and AdvUnlearn ( 27.50 27.50 ). This remaining gap is consistent with the training-free setting. HGSS leaves the U-Net frozen and intervenes only through text-side conditioning. The relevant gain is therefore the large matched improvement over SS, not necessarily because of weight editing on erase-side residual evidence. Preserve Neighbor P P /CLIP ( 30.04 30.04 ) stays within noise of the matched SS baseline ( 31.22 31.22 ). The Neighbor E E , Evasion, Attr E E , and Attr P P gains are all obtained at the same β \beta as the matched SS baseline, so the improvement reflects the new mechanisms rather than more aggressive editing.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the full SEE Table 3 (evasion) breakdown. HGSS achieves the strongest evasion score on every one of the 11 11 super-categories. Against weight-edit baselines the gain is large in every category (at least 2 × 2\times lower residual evasion everywhere, over 10 × 10\times in six of eleven categories). Against the matched SS baseline the gain is consistent but smaller and varies by category. The largest SS → \rightarrow HGSS drops occur on Electronic ( 35.16 → 2.34 35.16\to 2.34 ), Animal ( 33.75 → 1.56 33.75\to 1.56 ), Sports ( 30.47 → 4.37 30.47\to 4.37 ), and Furniture ( 29.95 → 4.69 29.95\to 4.69 ). The highest residual scores are on Indoor ( 25.45 25.45 ) and Kitchen ( 18.97 18.97 ), both compound-noun-heavy categories where the compound-head guard (Sec. 3.3 ) is intentionally conservative. This pattern is consistent with the ablation. Evasion gains come primarily from span grounding, while dynamic binding mainly recovers preserve-side fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了完整的SEE表3（规避）细分数据。 HGSS在全部11个超级类别中都获得了最强的规避得分。 与权重编辑基线相比，每个类别的增益都很显著（所有类别的剩余规避值至少低2倍，其中11个类别中有6个类别的降幅超过10倍）。 与匹配的SS基线相比，增益较为稳定但较小，且因类别而异。 SS → HGSS最大的得分下降出现在“电子”（35.16 → 2.34）、“动物”（33.75 → 1.56）、“体育”（30.47 → 4.37）和“家具”（29.95 → 4.69）类别中。 最高的剩余得分出现在“室内”（25.45）和“厨房”（18.97），这两个都是复合名词占主导的类别，其中复合词头保护机制（第3.3节）被刻意设计为保守模式。 这一模式与消融实验的结果一致。 规避得分的提升主要源于跨域接地，而动态绑定则主要用于恢复保留侧的保真度。

paragraphs.en: The gains concentrate on unlearning accuracy rather than uniformly improving all retention proxies. Style UA improves from 92.74 92.74 to 95.28 95.28 ( + 2.54 +2.54 ), style IRA from 94.93 94.93 to 97.28 97.28 ( + 2.35 +2.35 ), and object UA from 90.16 90.16 to 94.27 94.27 ( + 4.11 +4.11 ). Two of the six metrics, object IRA ( 98.27 → 94.63 98.27\to 94.63 ) and object CRA ( 99.15 → 95.58 99.15\to 95.58 ), decrease by 3 3 – 4 4 pp. This suggests that the SEE-oriented binding objective does not uniformly improve every classifier-based retention proxy in UC. Gains in style UA/IRA/CRA and object UA together offset the two object-retention losses. So HGSS is ahead of the matched SS baseline by 0.31 0.31 on the six-metric average. The COCO-30K FID of 56.15 56.15 improves over the matched SS baseline ( 56.77 56.77 ) by 0.62 0.62 points.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows a clean division of labour. paragraphs.en: This paper introduced HGSS, a training-free correction to text-side concept erasure for text-to-image diffusion models. Compositional erasure needs both target routing and preserve-side binding control. Hierarchical span grounding (what to edit) and dynamic attribute binding (how the edit evolves) together cast erasure as the inverse objective to compositional generation. Experiments on SEE and UnlearnCanvas support this view.
